description: Product requirements gap report — what's missing before convergence planning and feature build can proceed

missing.user_journeys: Full user journey definitions — founder workflow, agency client workflow, team member workflow
missing.screens: Complete screen inventory with wireframes or specifications
missing.data_model: Database schema specification — tables, relationships, constraints
missing.auth_session: Already uses Clerk — needs formal session management specification
missing.umh_integration: Formal UMH integration boundary — which substrate services EOS consumes
missing.analytics: Event taxonomy — what gets tracked, PostHog configuration
missing.deployment: Production deployment architecture — Fly.io configuration, domains, scaling
missing.business_model_assumptions: Pricing model, free tier, agency vs individual plans
missing.acceptance_criteria: MVP completion criteria — when is EOS 'done enough' to ship

entrepreneuros.blocker_reason: EntrepreneurOS Google Doc may not be a clean PRD. Full content read required to assess.

missing.user_journeys: Creator onboarding, course creation, community management, content publishing journeys
missing.screens: Complete screen inventory from PRD v2.90 (not readable)
missing.business_model_assumptions: Pricing model, creator monetization, platform fees

creatoros.blocker_reason: PRD v2.90 exists but cannot be read. It likely contains many of these answers. Live API access is the critical blocker.

missing.data_model: Game mechanics data model — levels, quests, achievements, progress tracking
missing.auth_session: Clerk migration plan from Passport.js + Firebase
missing.umh_integration: Formal UMH integration boundary — what distinguishes isolated MVP from UMH-connected MVP
missing.analytics: Event taxonomy — gamification events, progress tracking events
missing.deployment: Production deployment architecture — currently at lyfeos.net, target Fly.io?
missing.business_model_assumptions: Initiate Arena pricing, WHOP integration, Discord community economics
missing.onboarding: Player onboarding flow — beta access gating
missing.acceptance_criteria: Full UMH-connected MVP criteria vs current isolated MVP
missing.game_mechanics: Game of Lyfe system design — levels, rewards, challenges, progression
missing.coaching_integration: How coaching content maps to platform features

lyfeos.blocker_reason: LyfeOS Google Doc content not readable. Game mechanics and UMH integration requirements are the biggest unknowns.

missing.projection_registration_contract: How apps formally register as UMH projections
missing.cross_projection_analytics: Shared analytics strategy across Trinity apps
missing.multi_tenant_deployment: How UMH serves multiple projections in production
missing.shared_type_contract: TypeScript type sharing between apps and UMH
missing.api_contract_per_app: Which UMH API endpoints each app consumes

umh.blocker_reason: UMH substrate is well-documented in code. Missing pieces are integration boundaries that depend on app-level product docs.

primary_blockers: Google Docs full content access — PRDs exist but cannot be read
UMH integration boundaries not defined for any app
Acceptance criteria not defined for any app's MVP
overall_assessment.recommendation: Resolve Google Docs access first (Phase 14.3A). Then read full PRDs to close requirements gaps. Only then can convergence planning and feature build proceed.
